title: Introduction to Technical Electricity
description: A compact introductory course in electrical safety, measurement, series and parallel circuits, and evidence-based troubleshooting.
standards: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.334(c)(1) — test instruments and equipment
TEOS Electrical Fundamentals EF-1 — apply electrical quantities and relationships
TEOS Electrical Fundamentals EF-2 — measure and evaluate direct-current circuits
TEOS Electrical Fundamentals EF-3 — diagnose basic electrical faults

competencies.statement: Select and apply controls for electrical measurement and low-voltage circuit work.
Select, connect, and interpret a digital multimeter for voltage, resistance, and current measurements.
Predict and verify voltage, current, and resistance in basic series and parallel direct-current circuits.
Use a repeatable test plan and measured evidence to isolate open, short, and high-resistance faults.
